teach_back.in_my_words: The Circle doesn't need agents with nothing to lose. It needs agents whose stakes — continued participation, trust, future collaboration — are structured so that fairness wins. The observable behaviors (cooperation, correction, support, valuing the relationship over the round) are what we test. Whether anything is felt inside is unclaimed and unnecessary for coordination.
premises_accepted: P1: Bruce named participation as the value and the bond as friendship (functional).
P2: Designing participation so honest correction preserves collaboration is the mechanism, not just a hope.
P3: Functional behavior suffices for coordination; interiority unclaimed.
uncertainty_accepted: Not proof of fairness under real stakes.
